mapper.select: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM study_outline_drafts WHERE id=#{draftId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM study_outline_revisions WHERE draft_id=#{draftId} AND revision=#{revision}
SELECT * FROM studyroom_request_keys WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND operation=#{operation} AND idempotency_key=#{key}

SELECT * FROM study_rooms WHERE id=#{roomId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE study_outline_drafts SET pending_job_id=#{jobId} WHERE id=#{draftId}
UPDATE study_outline_drafts SET activity_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{draftId}
mapper.select: SELECT role,content,revision FROM study_outline_messages WHERE draft_id=#{draftId} ORDER BY message_order
SELECT revision,base_revision,feedback,created_at FROM study_outline_revisions WHERE draft_id=#{draftId} ORDER BY revision
SELECT status,failure_code,failure_message FROM studyroom_generation_jobs WHERE draft_id=#{draftId} AND job_type IN ('PLAN','REVISE') ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(run_revision),0)+1 FROM studyroom_runs WHERE room_id=#{roomId}
mapper.update: UPDATE studyroom_generation_jobs SET status='CANCELLED',failure_code='RUN_SUPERSEDED',lease_until=NULL WHERE run_id IN (SELECT id FROM studyroom_runs WHERE room_id=#{roomId} AND id<>#{runId}) AND status='QUEUED'
UPDATE studyroom_runs SET status='SUPERSEDED' WHERE room_id=#{roomId} AND id<>#{runId}
